inputs.convention: An emitter may read only files with a row in this manifest's `inputs`: inputs are declared or they are refused, and there is no ambient read. This is what makes hydration provenance enumerable — generated data is the Lean environment, plus store content, plus these rows, and nothing else.

rows.authority: hand-curated — nothing derives these rows, which is the point of writing them down
rows.role: the trust census's `model-gated` stratum: which TypeScript files the effects package ships are held to the Lean model, and by which conformance artifact, one gate label per row
